title: SuperDash 1.7 — Growth Application & Android Update Engine
summary: Introduced the brand-new Growth application (leads pipeline, relationship care, playbook & referrals), refined native Android APK update engine with live background downloads, and performance optimizations.
highlights: Brand new 'Growth' app: Leads pipeline, client relationship tracking, actionable playbooks & referral loop
Completely fixed Android update engine: Direct system download & automatic package installation
Live remote update checking across all Android versions
Liquid Glass Quick Controls Bottom Sheet from mobile header
Original SuperDash OS-grade squircle icons across all applications

changes.description: Marketing and client-retention app: Today action dashboard, lightweight leads pipeline, client relationship timeline, and 10 practical playbooks.
Resolved Android download issues with native DownloadManager integration, direct APK fallback, and live remote manifest queries.
Simplified Home composition: compact header, universal search, clean 4-column grid with Growth icon.
Header sliders button opens a native Liquid Glass Bottom Sheet without shifting or expanding the header.
